necessary_context.content: Definition 1: F_p(Delta,L_p) is the union over finite dimensions d of C-infinity functions R^d to R with globally L_p-Lipschitz pth derivative and f(0)-inf_x f(x)<=Delta. Section 2.1 defines smoothness through unit-direction projections; for these smooth functions the equivalent bound is ||nabla^(p+1) f(x)||_op<=L_p for every x.
